text:
2026-07-08 (July 6, 2026, Hong Kong) A Confucian and Taoist cultural exchange event, organized by local private equity firm RF Capital, was successfully held recently at the Asia Society Hong Kong Centre in Admiralty. As a partner of the event, SeerQ specially dispatched its Chief Divination Consultant, Sister Mu Yun, to Hong Kong to discuss the future direction of Hong Kong's economy using Qimen Dunjia. Mr. Guo Sizhi (Guo Sir), Vice Chairman of the Hong Kong Stock Analysts Association and a renowned stock commentator, was invited as a special guest to help attendees grasp economic opportunities and gain insights into trends. SeerQ: Interpreting Eastern Wisdom with Technology As a leading global one-stop "health and life planning" platform, SeerQ is committed to revitalizing ancient wisdom with technology, providing users with professional and compassionate life guidance services. Sister Mu Yun is a professional mentor with profound expertise in numerology under SeerQ, a disciple of Master Huang Jingsi and Zhang Jiyu of Longhu Mountain. Influenced by the novel *Romance of the Three Kingdoms* from a young age, coupled with her Chaoshan cultural background, she developed a strong interest in traditional numerology, ultimately focusing on the study of Qimen Dunjia. This cultural exchange event, co-hosted with Linfeng Capital, embodies SeerQ's mission to promote the modernization and integration of traditional culture into daily life—through the platform's rigorous mentor qualification certification mechanism, introducing users to professional consultants like Sister Mu Yun, realizing the vision of "human-machine collaboration," and assisting users in navigating changing circumstances. The I Ching is not superstition; it's an ancient decision-making model. During the sharing session, Sister Mu Yun stated that she hoped to provide investors with a completely new perspective on decision-making. "Many people find the I Ching mysterious, but in fact, numerology is a form of mathematical modeling, and there are patterns to follow," she said. She explained that the Three Cycles and Nine Periods and Qimen Dunjia are essentially ancient tools for deducing the laws of time and space, and they are even more valuable in today's changing world. She described Qimen Dunjia as a decision-making model that integrates time, space, imagery, number, and principle, emphasizing the right timing, location, and human factors. "It's not about fate, but about helping people make more advantageous judgments at crucial moments." "A Year of Prosperity is Coming: True Gold Fears No Fire" When discussing the economic situation in 2026, she described the market volatility as a "year of prosperity." "This year, the fire is very strong; only true gold fears no fire," she analyzed, the financial market volatility will intensify, leading companies will be more resilient, while retail investors should be cautious. "Cash is king this year; avoid excessive speculation and chasing high prices." She pointed out that future attention should be paid to technology industries related to "fire," such as artificial intelligence, computing power, chips, and robotics, while also keeping an eye on infrastructure projects related to electricity and energy. “Fire represents technology, but fire is unstable and needs earth to ground it.” From a macro perspective, she believes sectors such as technology, aviation, and deep-sea exploration have long-term potential, and related energy and materials will also benefit; conversely, some traditional industries, such as baijiu and real estate, will face pressure to transform. Flexible Investment Strategies: Semiconductors and Memory Chips Emerge as Major Trends
Discussing the Hong Kong stock market, she noted that the Hang Seng Index is heavily influenced by the performance of U.S. stocks and the strength of the U.S. dollar. She expects volatility to remain high throughout the year, advising investors to adopt flexible strategies and take profits when opportunities arise. However, she believes the overall market outlook need not be overly pessimistic and anticipates a “July rebound” in July.
Guest Mr. Guo also agreed, stating that it is not advisable to be overly bearish on the overall trend of the Hong Kong stock market. From a technical analysis perspective, if the market can stage a relatively significant rebound and successfully reclaim the 10-day moving average, it would indicate that the downtrend has initially stabilized, with a greater chance of initiating a technical recovery. In the long term, he believes there may be an opportunity for another “super bull market” between 2029 and 2030. However, he also reminded investors that risk management should always be a top priority, and they should never put all their eggs in one basket.
Furthermore, he agrees with Master Muyun’s observation that memory and chips will become major trends. As market demand continues to rise, the world’s top three semiconductor memory manufacturers—Micron Technology (U.S.), SK Hynix (South Korea), and Samsung Electronics—are all actively expanding production capacity and increasing investment in their facilities.
The Business World Is Like a Battlefield: One More Tool Means One More Advantage
Master Muyun also mentioned that several new consumer trends are worth watching, including the visual economy, the wellness economy, the silver economy, the single economy, and the “she-economy,” as consumer behavior shifts from a functional focus to emotional and experiential value. “The business world is like a battlefield; every additional tool gives you an edge.” She hopes that through this sharing session, the public will gain a new understanding of I Ching through a scientific lens, believing that “only by understanding trends can one strategize effectively.” About “SeerQ”
SeerQ is a trust-based AI platform for mental and physical well-being and personal growth. It blends thousands of years of traditional Asian wisdom with modern technology to provide 24/7 mental and physical support and guidance to Asian communities across Asia and around the world, bridging health disparities through Eastern cultural values. With the core vision of “helping everyone find their direction, see more possibilities, and live a better life,” the platform combines modern technology with traditional wisdom and brings together the world’s finest mentors to become the most trusted platform for mental and physical well-being and life guidance. Master Muyun serves as the platform’s Chief Divination Consultant, specializing in providing users with decision-making guidance based on Qimen Dunjia and traditional I Ching principles.
